name: sciprep
description: A structured chemistry and physics foundation course for non-science learners

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run content:validate && npm run build
scripts.mobile:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.android:assemble: npm run mobile:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.android:bundle: npm run mobile:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat bundleRelease
